about: Codes a pasted W_ROOM_NO_FIXTURE / W_ROOM_MISSING_DEFINING hint set was measured to gain, with the rule that emits each (PR #216, plan-soundness PS2.17). Measured with the set verification off, pasting every quoted set into its plan: the A+B fuzz corpora (PS2.9's, 1,413 sets) and every single-storey corpus .arch (102 sets), under the default ruleset, accessibility-advisory and residential-basic; plus W_FIXTURE_BACK_TO_ROOM, measured on f7d6f6d before the corner-rotation fix (17 of 687 fuzz kitchen sets). The rules flagged readsFurniture in src/ are exactly these.
